fullTextEN: Hello, everyone!
I am Nika.
I come from Anhui, China,

fullTextZH: 现在住在安徽省合肥市。
fullTextEN: and now live in Hefei, Anhui Province.
Do you like drinking milk tea?
Do you know the cheapest,

fullTextZH: 最火的奶茶店是什么吗？
fullTextEN: most popular milk tea shop in China?
It's called Mixue Bingcheng.
Their drinks are very cheap.

fullTextZH: 一杯柠檬水只要四元人民币，
fullTextEN: A cup of lemonade costs only four yuan,
which is about 0.6 USD.

fullTextZH: 一杯奶茶只要六元人民币，
fullTextEN: A cup of milk tea costs only six yuan,
which is about 0.9 USD.
However,

fullTextZH: 这个奶茶店是中国赚钱最多的奶茶店。
fullTextEN: this milk tea shop is the most profitable in China.

fullTextZH: 为什么最便宜的奶茶店赚钱最多呢？
fullTextEN: Why does the cheapest milk tea shop earn the most?
Why can their lemonade,
sell a billion cups a year?

fullTextZH: 一开始，我看不上蜜雪冰城。
fullTextEN: At first, I looked down on Mixue Bingcheng.
Why?
Hmm, because it's too cheap.
I thought to myself:
"So cheap,
can it taste good?"
I think, hmm,
cheap things might not be good.

fullTextZH: 我喜欢买的是那种贵一点的奶茶，
fullTextEN: I like to buy that kind of slightly expensive milk tea,
one cup costs 20 RMB,
about 2.9 USD.
Holding it in hand,
hmm, it feels very high-end,
and it looks good in photos.

fullTextZH: 那时候，我和我的朋友都觉得，
fullTextEN: At that time, my friends and I all thought,

fullTextZH: 喝贵的奶茶是一件很酷的事情。
fullTextEN: drinking expensive milk tea was a very cool thing.
But later, the situation changed,
because money became hard to earn.
Many people lost their jobs,

fullTextZH: 丢了工作，或者找不到工作。
fullTextEN: lost their jobs, or couldn't find work.

fullTextZH: 所以大家都不愿意花钱了，
fullTextEN: So everyone was unwilling to spend money,
and became more careful with spending.
Me too.

fullTextZH: 但是，我还是想喝好喝的饮料，
fullTextEN: However, I still want to drink tasty drinks,
But buying one for 30 yuan every day,
My wallet really can't take it.

fullTextZH: 这时候，我听到了那首歌。
fullTextEN: At that time, I heard that song.
It was probably in 2021,

fullTextZH: 有一首歌突然火了起来。
fullTextEN: A song suddenly became popular.

fullTextZH: 它就是蜜雪冰城的主题曲，
fullTextEN: It was the theme song of Mixue Bingcheng,
The song of Mixue Bingcheng.
You walk on the street,
Open your phone,
You can hear it everywhere.
Its lyrics are super simple,
There are only three lines: "You love me,

fullTextZH: 我爱你，蜜雪冰城甜蜜蜜。”
fullTextEN: I love you, Mixue Bingcheng sweet sweet."
It's probably sung like this, hmm:

fullTextZH: “你爱我，我爱你，蜜雪冰城甜蜜蜜。”
fullTextEN: "You love me, I love you, Mixue Bingcheng sweet sweet."
It's probably sung like this.

fullTextZH: 因为这首歌，蜜雪冰城突然变得很火，
fullTextEN: Because of this song, Mixue Bingcheng suddenly became very popular,

fullTextZH: 很多人排队买他们的饮料，
fullTextEN: Many people lined up to buy their drinks,
It's because of this song.
I started to seriously notice
I didn't care about this before,
the milk tea shop I looked down on.
I thought to myself: Hmm,
that so many people line up for,
why don't I try it too?

fullTextZH: 有一天，我点了一杯最火、最经典的，
fullTextEN: One day, I ordered the most popular and classic one,
a four-yuan lemonade.

fullTextZH: 当我喝下第一口的时候，
fullTextEN: When I took the first sip,
I was a bit surprised.
It was sweet and sour, very refreshing,
the lemon flavor was very fresh,

fullTextZH: 一点也不比那些贵的饮料差。
fullTextEN: not worse than those expensive drinks at all.

fullTextZH: 我的想法一下子改变了：
fullTextEN: My thoughts changed instantly:

fullTextZH: 不是所有便宜的东西都不好。
fullTextEN: not all cheap things are bad.
Later, I learned that

fullTextZH: 蜜雪冰城为了把这杯柠檬水做得又好、
fullTextEN: Mixue Bingcheng made a lot of effort to make this lemonade both good,
and sell it cheaply,
they made a lot of effort,
Spent a lot of effort.

fullTextZH: 他们可能尝试了世界上所有的柠檬，
fullTextEN: They might have tried all the lemons in the world,
Found what they think is the best,
the most suitable lemon variety,

fullTextZH: 然后和种柠檬的农民合作，
fullTextEN: then cooperated with lemon farmers,

fullTextZH: 在种柠檬的地方建了工厂。
fullTextEN: and built a factory where lemons are grown.

fullTextZH: 这样，他们可以有最便宜、最好的柠檬。
fullTextEN: In this way, they can have the cheapest and best lemons.

fullTextZH: 他们也可以把柠檬卖给别的公司，
fullTextEN: They can also sell lemons to other companies,

fullTextZH: 种柠檬的农民不用担心卖不出去，
fullTextEN: so lemon farmers don't have to worry about not selling them,

fullTextZH: 因为蜜雪冰城是一个很大的公司，
fullTextEN: because Mixue Bingcheng is a very large company,
they will collect a lot of lemons.

fullTextZH: 他们的目标是：让每个人，不管有钱没钱，
fullTextEN: Their goal is: to let everyone, regardless of wealth,

fullTextZH: 都能喝到一杯又好喝又便宜的饮料。
fullTextEN: be able to drink a tasty and cheap beverage.
This kind of idea makes me admire them.
When other milk tea shops

fullTextZH: 需要不断地研究新的奶茶
fullTextEN: need to constantly research new milk teas
to attract us to buy,

fullTextZH: 蜜雪冰城就一直保持低价。
fullTextEN: Mixue Bingcheng just keeps prices low.

fullTextZH: 柠檬水一年可以卖十亿杯，
fullTextEN: Lemonade can sell a billion cups a year,

fullTextZH: 因为他们在中国很多地方
fullTextEN: because they are in many places in China
They all have their own factories.

fullTextZH: 慢慢的，我就成了蜜雪冰城的粉丝。
fullTextEN: Gradually, I became a fan of Mixue Bingcheng.
And also their ice cream,

fullTextZH: 一直都只卖两元人民币，
fullTextEN: It has always been sold for only two yuan,
About 0.29
dollars, and it's huge!
Hmm, the taste is also very good,

fullTextZH: 也是他家最受欢迎的产品之一。
fullTextEN: It's also one of their most popular products.

fullTextZH: 当然，他家也有不好喝的奶茶，
fullTextEN: Of course, they also have milk tea that doesn't taste good,

fullTextZH: 比如一个叫黑糖珍珠奶茶的，
fullTextEN: like one called brown sugar pearl milk tea,
I think it's too sweet,
not what I like.

fullTextZH: 当我开始注意蜜雪冰城，
fullTextEN: When I started to notice Mixue Bingcheng,

fullTextZH: 我发现这个奶茶店很有意思。
fullTextEN: I found this milk tea shop very interesting.
They don't hire celebrities to endorse,
nor do they hire celebrities for advertising.

fullTextZH: 他有自己的卡通代言人，
fullTextEN: They have their own cartoon spokesperson,
not a celebrity,
but a chubby snowman,
called Snow King.

fullTextZH: 蜜雪冰城为雪王做了很多的动画片、
fullTextEN: Mixue Bingcheng made many cartoons for Snow King,
and short videos are posted online,

fullTextZH: 让大家觉得这个胖胖的雪人
fullTextEN: making everyone think this chubby snowman
is our good friend.

fullTextZH: 现在，我很少买很贵的奶茶，
fullTextEN: Now, I rarely buy very expensive milk tea,

fullTextZH: 我觉得蜜雪冰城又便宜又好喝。
fullTextEN: I think Mixue Bingcheng is both cheap and tasty.

fullTextZH: 这就是我最喜欢它的原因。
fullTextEN: This is why I like it the most.
Now, Mixue Bingcheng is in China,

fullTextZH: 不管你去大城市还是小地方，
fullTextEN: no matter if you go to big cities or small places,
you can almost always find its store.

fullTextZH: 更厉害、更让我骄傲的是，
fullTextEN: Even more impressive, what makes me proud is,

fullTextZH: 蜜雪冰城不止在中国开了很多店，
fullTextEN: Mixue Bingcheng has opened many stores not only in China,

fullTextZH: 他在泰国、越南、日本……很多国家都开了店！
fullTextEN: it has opened stores in Thailand, Vietnam, Japan... many countries!
I saw online,

fullTextZH: 外国朋友也在排队买我们的蜜雪冰城。
fullTextEN: foreign friends are also lining up to buy our Mixue Bingcheng.
They would say: "So cheap,
and the taste is so good!"

fullTextZH: 为了适合外国朋友的口味，
fullTextEN: To suit the tastes of foreign friends,

fullTextZH: 蜜雪冰城也会做一点小小的改变，
fullTextEN: Mixue Bingcheng will also make some small changes,

fullTextZH: 比如在某些地方把饮料做得，嗯，
fullTextEN: for example, in some places making drinks, um,
A bit sweeter.
I heard that in the United States,
you can choose 200% sweetness,

fullTextZH: 可以喝到非常非常甜的蜜雪冰城。
fullTextEN: and drink very, very sweet Mixue Bingcheng.
So now if you ask me:
"Which is your favorite drink shop?"

fullTextZH: 我一定会大声地告诉你：“是蜜雪冰城！”
fullTextEN: I will definitely tell you loudly: "It's Mixue Bingcheng!"
